{{Quote|I'll take these&hellip;uh&hellip;this one!|Llez, ready to do battle with a Dyclops|<ref name="SWD3" />}}
The '''Dyclops''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who, despite their mostly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body, were distinguished by their two heads, both of which featured a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], a single [[Eye/Legends|eye]], and an [[Ear/Legends|ear]]. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Unidentified Dyclops pirate|Dyclops]] had joined the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group led by [[Reddjak]]. The Dyclops served as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard the ''[[Blood Brother]]'', Reddjak's [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Hitting_that_Dyclops.png|thumb|left|200px|A Dyclops hit in the chest]]
The Dyclops were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of two-headed [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], similar in that respect<ref name="SWD3" /> to the [[Troig/Legends|Troigs]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pollillus/Legends|Pollillus]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Other than that, their body was similar to that of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], since they walked on two [[Limb/Legends|legs]], had an upper torso, and two arms. They had knees that bent forward, allowing them to sit on their buttocks or haunches with their back upright. When seated, a Dyclops was considerably taller than an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], which stood 0.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Height" />

A Dyclops had two [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-shaped heads, each featuring a lipped [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] and a single [[Eye/Legends|eye]] shadowed by a dark [[Hair/Legends|eyebrow]]. A single, fleshy [[Ear/Legends|ear]] emerged from the outer side of each head. Once opened, each mouth revealed a full set of [[Color/Legends|white]], blunt [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. However, they lacked an apparent [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and were also hairless except for their eyebrows. At least one individual belonging to the species sported purple skin, and both their irises and sclerae were yellow. Dyclops had four-fingered hands with an opposable thumb that allowed them to finely grasp and handle objects. Their fingers had rounded, swollen tips and displayed characteristic horizontal indentations. The upper [[Breast/Legends|chest]] of a Dyclops was one of their vulnerable points, and a direct hit there could knock an individual unconscious.<ref name="SWD3" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Firing all plasma torpedoes now, Captain!''"<br />"''Heh, heh&hellip;Just like shooting acid rats in a crater!|The two heads of a Dyclops pirate|<ref name="SWD3" />}}
As was the case with the Troigs,<ref name="NEGAS" /> the two heads of a Dyclops were treated as a single individual. Sometimes, the two heads shared thoughts, one beginning a sentence and the other finishing it. Like many humanoids, they expressed mirth by smiling and laughing. At least one Dyclops spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] fluently.<ref name="SWD3" />

==Dyclops in the galaxy==
In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Unidentified Dyclops pirate|Dyclops]] participated in [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and served as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard the ''[[Blood Brother]]'', a modified [[Consular III-class cruiser|''Consular III''-class cruiser]] commanded by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reddjak]], leader of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]]. [[Llez]], a green-skinned [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] who had been lured aboard the ''Blood Brother'' on one occasion, incapacitated the Dyclops. [[Zell]], [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the planet [[Majoor]] and [[Parent/Legends|father]] of Llez, later ordered the gunner's arrest along with the rest of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] crew.<ref name="SWD3" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Dwuirsintabb.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A two-headed Troig]]
{{Quote|Would've been nice if it/they could've been a Troig, but it just wasn't matching up. I've learned through trial and error not to make the galaxy unnecessarily small.|Abel G. Peña|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50801413|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-06-15|archivedate=20180316143709}}</ref>}}
A Dyclops was a member of a pirate crew in [[Droids (1986) 3|''Droids'' (1986) 3]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] first published by [[Marvel Comics|Marvel's]] Star Comics imprint<ref name="SWD3" /> on [[May 13]], [[1986]].<ref name="Droids 3 date">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 40|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[July]] [[1986]]|issn=8750-4367}}</ref> The character was created by writer [[David Manak|Dave Manak]] and artist [[John Romita Sr.]].<ref name="SWD3" /> In [[June]] [[2013]], writers [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] identified the character's species in the first part of the article "[[The Droids Re-Animated]]," published in the official [[Star Wars Blog]].<ref name="DRA">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> On [[TheForce.net]]'s [[Jedi Council Forums]], Peña later noted that he had considered identifying the two-headed character as a Troig, but the details simply did not match well enough.<ref name="JCF" /> Indeed, the Troigs have four arms, a tail with a spiked bulge, and each of their heads has two eyes and two ears.<ref name="NEGAS" />
